_meta: Four candidate tool-call strings the model emitted, as raw text. A strict JSON parser accepts only perfectly-formed JSON, but models routinely wrap the call in a Markdown code fence, leave a trailing comma, or make a similar surface-level mistake -- syntactically invalid JSON that nonetheless expresses a perfectly clear call. Aborting the whole turn on such a string wastes the step. A lightweight REPAIR pass (strip code fences, remove trailing commas) recovers the common malformations before parsing, without any model round-trip. It does not fix everything: 'missing_comma' is a structural error simple repair cannot mend, and it stays broken -- repair recovers the easy cases, not all cases. Each candidate is the exact raw string; kind labels why it is malformed.
